IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Early Learning & Human Services (originally sponsored by Representatives Hurst and Dahlquist)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the children of family day care providers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to children of family day care providers; andadding a new section to chapter 43.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.215 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The children of family day care providers, who are present in thehome where child care is provided and who are twelve years of age orolder, shall not be counted in the stafftochild ratio required by thedepartment for family day care providers. These children are notsubject to the supervision requirements established by the departmentfor child care licensing.
